dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim
dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.

limitations: Eight finite requests include initial Prefill and final drain.
No external PD import, constant full-batch steady state, or paper model/hardware accuracy is claimed.
Original synthetic hardware assumptions are retained; this is not a device performance prediction.

live_physical_cores.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization

native_collective_graph.scope: compiled native graphs of realized cohorts, not an additional simulation or retained transaction trace

parameters.hbf_protocol: generic analytical NAND page service, not OCP

scope: native functional pilot, not paper results or steady-state TPS
